body: A new friend recently shared this beautiful TED talk by Elizabeth Gilbert. I think it’s interesting for those who struggle with the biblical language of angels and demons … showing how parallel language has been used in other cultures to try to access the profound and mysterious depths of human experience. But more, I think it’s useful for all of us who experience the creative process – preaching sermons, writing books, cooking meals, dancing dances, painting paintings, writing songs, raising kids, living life. Enjoy …
